mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS productImage, l.enter_time AS enterTime, l.leave_time AS leaveTime, l.duration, l.client_ip AS clientIp, l.terminal, l.source_type AS sourceType FROM t_user_browse_log l LEFT JOIN nxg.t_product p ON l.product_id = p.id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.enter_time DESC

SELECT l.id, l.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS productPic, p.price AS price, l.enter_time AS enterTime, l.duration FROM nxg_analytics.t_user_browse_log l LEFT JOIN nxg.t_product p ON l.product_id = p.id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.enter_time DESC
